device.name: BME280 SensorAPI initialization and humidity-configuration slice

scope.description: Reviewed initialization, reset-settle, calibration-read and sleep-mode humidity configuration slice for the pinned Bosch SensorAPI.
unsupported: early reset-status polling inside the settle interval
multi-byte writes and registers outside this slice

write_constraints.reason: Measurement modes are outside the Stage 4 slice

evidence.summary: The specified startup time bound is 2 ms.
The humidity calibration layout continues through 0xE7.
The map identifies chip ID, reset, status and control registers; reset command 0xB6 performs complete reset.
Status exposes im_update and ctrl_meas completes the humidity-control latch.
Multiple-byte reads use an auto-incremented register address.
Multiple-byte writes are address/data pairs rather than ordinary incrementing writes.
A 2000 us observation boundary conservatively combines the source startup maximum with the upstream wait.

review.review_basis: Checked against the pinned Bosch PDF pages 8, 24, 25, 27, 28, 32 and 33. The 2000 us observation boundary is accepted as an explicit conservative abstraction, not a claim of exact internal reset timing.
limitations: Calibration bytes are separate synthetic device-instance data, not datasheet defaults.
Reset readiness inside the 2000 us boundary is intentionally out of model.
Only initialization and sleep-mode humidity configuration are covered.
